categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Nanowin Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in high-performance nanosphere materials research, large-scale production, sales, and application services. Its main application fields include biopharmaceutical processes, flat panel displays, analytical testing, and in vitro diagnostics. The company also provides chromatographic fillers, chromatographic media, chromatographic instruments, protein chromatography systems, liquid chromatography columns, and purification technology services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary technologies in precise nanosphere preparation, including monodisperse porous silica and polymer microspheres, chiral silica chromatographic fillers, surface hydrophilization and functionalization of polymer chromatographic media, and soft gel affinity chromatographic media. It employs advanced synthesis, surface modification, and large-scale production techniques to control particle size, pore size, and surface functional groups with high precision. The company also develops chromatographic instruments and integrated purification systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are biopharmaceutical companies, pharmaceutical manufacturers, research institutions, and diagnostic reagent producers. The company serves markets including biopharmaceutical process purification, analytical testing for pharmaceuticals, food safety, environmental monitoring, flat panel display manufacturing, and in vitro diagnostics. Major end markets include antibody production, ADC drugs, GLP-1 peptides, vaccines, nucleic acid drugs, and LCD panel manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Suzhou, Changshu, Nantong, and Zhejiang. It has subsidiaries and business operations in the United States, India, and other international markets. The company actively expands overseas markets through participation in international exhibitions and establishing local technical teams, especially in the US, Europe, India, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Nanowin operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of core nanosphere materials and chromatographic media. It also integrates downstream by providing chromatographic instruments and purification systems, offering comprehensive solutions to biopharmaceutical and analytical customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-performance nanosphere materials and chromatographic media, targeting key biopharmaceutical applications such as antibody purification, ADC, nucleic acid synthesis, and peptide drugs. It invests heavily in R&D (22.64% of revenue in 2024) to develop new products like NMab Titan soft gel affinity media, NMOligo solid-phase synthesis carriers, and advanced chromatographic columns. The strategy includes expanding international markets, integrating acquisitions (e.g., Fuli Instruments), and enhancing digital and operational capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-performance nanosphere materials, chromatographic fillers and media, analytical instruments, protein chromatography systems, and related consumables. The company also earns income from providing purification technology services and integrated solutions. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales and some distribution channels, with a focus on long-term strategic customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China’s high-performance nanosphere and chromatographic media market, breaking foreign monopolies held by multinational corporations like Cytiva, Merck, and Thermo Fisher. It competes with international giants in biopharmaceutical purification materials and analytical instruments, while also facing increasing competition from domestic peers. Its integrated product platform and strong R&D capabilities position it as a key challenger in the global market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 782 million, a 33.33% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 82.84 million, up 20.82%. The company’s R&D investment increased by 9.61% to RMB 177 million, accounting for 22.64% of revenue. It has expanded through acquisitions, including a controlling stake in Fuli Instruments, and maintains strong cash flow and asset growth, with total assets reaching RMB 2.31 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Nanowin offers highly uniform, monodisperse nanosphere materials with precise control over particle size, pore size, and surface chemistry, enabling superior chromatographic performance. Its products provide high mechanical strength, chemical stability, and biocompatibility, supporting efficient and scalable biopharmaceutical purification processes. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive product lines, integrated instrument and consumable solutions, strong application support, and a robust quality management system, facilitating import substitution and meeting stringent international standards.
